info.name: Auth API - JWT + Roles (Task 3)
info.description:
Postman collection for the authentication / authorisation layer of the Enischyo job board API.

## Before you start
1. `cd backend`
2. `npm run seed` (creates the 4 demo users used below + 15 jobs they own)
3. `npm run dev`
4. Send the requests in folder order — the tokens are captured automatically into collection variables.

## Demo accounts (created by seed.js)
| Role | Email | Password |
|------|-------|----------|
| admin | admin@enischyo.test | Admin12345! |
| employer | employer1@enischyo.test | Employer12345! |
| employer | employer2@enischyo.test | Employer12345! |
| jobseeker | jobseeker1@enischyo.test | Jobseeker12345! |

## How the tokens are handled
`POST /auth/login` (and `POST /auth/register`) return a JWT. Each request in this collection runs a test script that stores the token in a collection variable (`adminToken`, `employerToken`, `otherEmployerToken`, `jobseekerToken`). The protected requests then send `Authorization: Bearer {{employerToken}}` automatically — no copy/pasting.

## ⚠️ Login is rate limited
`POST /auth/login` allows **5 attempts per 15 minutes per IP**. The login folder uses exactly 5, and the last request proves the 6th one is refused with **429**. After running that folder you must wait 15 minutes (or restart the server, because the counter is in memory) before logging in again.

## Folders
1. **Auth - Register** – validation, duplicate email, admin signup refused
2. **Auth - Login** – the 5 attempts + the 429 rate-limit proof
3. **Profile (/auth/me)** – token required / missing / invalid
4. **Change Password** – PATCH /auth/change-password
5. **Protected Jobs** – employer-only POST, owner-only PUT, owner-or-admin DELETE
6. **Protected Applications** – jobseeker-only POST, admin-only PUT/DELETE
7. **Admin Deletes** – 403 for non-admins, 200 for admins

All routes exist twice: `/auth/login` and `/api/auth/login`.

item.name: 4. Change Password
item.description: PATCH /auth/change-password — requires a token and the CURRENT password. Uses the token from POST /auth/register, so it does not consume the login budget.

item.name: 6. Protected Applications
item.description: POST /applications → jobseekers only. PUT/DELETE → admins only.

item.name: GET /jobs (public) -> saves a job to apply to

request.description: Grabs a job id so the application below always has a valid target.

{
  "job": "{{applyJobId}}",
  "applicantName": "Postman Jobseeker",
  "email": "postman.applicant@enischyo.test",
  "phone": "+92 300 1234567",
  "coverLetter": "This application was sent from Postman with a jobseeker JWT to prove that only jobseekers can apply for a job.",
  "resumeURL": "https://example.com/resume/postman.pdf"
}

request.description: A jobseeker token is required to reach the controller.

request.description: Valid token, wrong role → 403.
Reviewing an application is a back-office action, so it is admin-only.
A jobseeker cannot accept their own application.
Only admins delete resources.
Cleans up the application created earlier.

item.name: 7. Admin Deletes
item.description: "Only admins can delete any resource" — the same rule on the companies, posts and comments endpoints.

request.description: Also fills {{companyId}}, which the POST /jobs request in folder 5 needs.
The blog endpoints still read publicly, but deleting now needs an admin token.
Being logged in is not enough — the role must be admin.
Deletes seeded comment 6. Run `npm run seed` to restore it.
Deleting a company cascades to its jobs and applications, so it stays admin-only.
